changelog.title: UI Fix: Control Cluster
changelog.description: SoundToggle now stacks above FluxCapacitor in bottom-right corner. Fixed Divergent mode crash and duplicate AchievementSystem conflict.

changelog.title: Windows Server Administration Course
changelog.description: New WSA course with Module 01 complete - Server Manager GUI lab, PowerShell terminal lab, and 10-question quiz. AZ-800 certification aligned.

changelog.title: PowerShell Terminal Engine
changelog.description: New PowerShell-style terminal for Windows Server labs with PS C:\> prompt, simulated cmdlets (Get-Service, Get-ComputerInfo, Get-WindowsFeature), and command history.
